# ZeroTouch Support — Full Review Catalog

> All 32 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-09-12.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## 800.com
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/800-com-review.html
- Verdict: 800.com — On yearly billing: Startup $19/mo, Small Business $49/mo and Complete $99/mo. The 1,000-minute cap on Startup matters for higher call volume.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-13, read on their own plans page with both billing tabs open) No free tier. On yearly billing: Startup $19/mo, Small Business $49/mo and Complete $99/mo; the same three month-to-month are $23, $59 and $119, badged SAVE 15%.

## Aircall
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/aircall-review.html
- Verdict: Aircall: Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing. 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions — check yours.
- Price: (read 2026-08-26 on aircall.io/pricing over a US connection, with their own country selector on United States) Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing, which the page marks as 25% off monthly. Flip that toggle and the monthly rates read $40 and $70 per license (3 licenses for $120 and $210), checked 29 August 2026 from a US connection.

## Answering Service Care
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/answering-service-care-review.html
- Verdict: Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.
- Price: (2026-09-10, read off their own pricing page, both billing toggles) Four plans, priced on included minutes. Billed monthly: Starter $40 with zero minutes included and $1.75 per minute after that; Small Business $179 for 100 minutes, then $1.70; Pro $329 for 250 minutes, then $1.60; Enterprise $639 for 500 minutes, then $1.35.

## Calilio
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/calilio-review.html
- Verdict: Calilio: Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year). The subscription is the platform, not the talking.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17) Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year); Premium $35 per user/mo, or $28 annually ($336 a year); Enterprise custom. Annual billing saves 20%.

## CallHippo
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/callhippo-review.html
- Verdict: CallHippo: The same grid read in dollars on 19 July 2026 showed $19, $30 and $42. 'Unlimited calling' is unlimited to the US and Canada.
- Price: (2026-08-15, read on their own pricing page in euros) Starter €19/user/mo, Professional €29 and Ultimate €39 on monthly billing for a 1-4 user team, above a genuinely free Basic tier where you pay only for the numbers. Unlimited landline and mobile minutes start at Starter with 100 SMS; call recordings, AI voicemail transcription and multilingual IVR at Professional with 500 SMS; smart DID, multilevel and holiday…

## CloudTalk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloudtalk-review.html
- Verdict: CloudTalk: Lite €19, Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing. The per-seat price is only part of it.
- Price: Lite €19, Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing, and Expert needs at least 3 licences (re-verified 2026-08-16). The add-ons are where the bill grows: Power Dialer €15 per user/mo (already included in Expert), Parallel Dialer €39 per user/mo, AI Conversation Intelligence €9 per user/mo.

## Cloze
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloze-review.html
- Verdict: Cloze: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. The second is the track record, or the absence of one.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-04 on apps.shopify.com/cloze, listed as “Cloze: AI Shopping Assistant”) Free plan available: 25 AI conversations a month, up to 100 synced products, core assistant customisation and 7 days of conversation history. Paid tiers are Starter $49, Pro $99 and Scale $199 a month, each with $0.10 per additional AI conversation and a 3-day free trial.

## CometChat
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html
- Verdict: CometChat — Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359. The pricing cliff is the honest headline.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 against CometChat's own machine-readable pricing reference, which they publish for AI agents and last verified themselves on 2026-05-20; USD) Build is free for development: all features, up to 100 users and 25 concurrent connections, no card. Paid Chat plans are priced by monthly active users.

## CrankWheel
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/crankwheel-review.html
- Verdict: CrankWheel: A free plan with no payment details required. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it.
- Price: (read on crankwheel.com/pricing, 2026-08-21) A free plan with no payment details required — unlimited usage for the first 15 days, then up to 15 sessions a month for life. Solo is $29/month for one user with unlimited usage, up to 30 viewers per share and up to 10 video-conferencing participants.

## eDesk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/edesk-review.html
- Verdict: eDesk: Free plan to start; Essential $39 per agent/mo, Growth $89 (recommended), Professional $119, Enterprise custom.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17) Free plan to start; Essential $39 per agent/mo, Growth $89 (recommended), Professional $119, Enterprise custom — all billed annually, with monthly billing 20% higher ($49 against $39 on Essential). The AI Agent is included on every paid tier, but its automated resolutions bill separately at $0.99 per outcome: you pay when it actually resolves a query, not per attempt.

## Fireflies.ai
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/fireflies-ai-review.html
- Verdict: Fireflies.ai: Free $0 — unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 mins storage per team, 20 AI credits. AI credits are capped on every tier.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page, read from a European exit) Free $0 — unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 mins storage per team, 20 AI credits. Pro $18/seat/mo month-to-month or $10/seat/mo billed annually — unlimited AI summaries, 8,000 mins storage per seat, 20 AI credits.

## Freshworks
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/freshworks-review.html
- Verdict: Freshworks — On Freshdesk the annual rates are unchanged since 1 August 2026: Growth $19 per agent per month, Pro $55, Enterprise $89, billed annually.
- Price: (2026-08-29, read on their own pricing pages) The main Freshworks pricing page still carries no prices at all — it lists the products and links out to each one, and that list has grown to nine: Freshdesk Omni, Freshdesk, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshservice, Freshservice for Business Teams, Freshsales, Freshsales Suite and Freshmarketer. On Freshdesk the annual rates are unchanged since 1 August 2026: Growth $19…

## Gorgias
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/gorgias-review.html
- Verdict: Gorgias: Not priced per agent -- their own line -- but the seats are capped. Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up.
- Price: (re-verified 8 September 2026 on their own pricing page) Not priced per agent -- their own line -- but the seats are capped: the comparison table gives Starter 3 user seats and Basic, Pro and Advanced 500 each. Two meters stack.

## HelpCenter
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/helpcenter-review.html
- Verdict: HelpCenter: Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that. The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason people stay.
- Price: (re-read 2026-08-29 on apps.shopify.com/helpcenter) Free to install, and the meter is tickets rather than agents — Basic already gives unlimited support agents, then bills for every ticket over the allowance. Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that.

## Kixie
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/kixie-review.html
- Verdict: Kixie: No seat price is published. Plan for 30-60% above the sticker: minutes, the multi-line dialer and AI human-voice-detection all bill separately.
- Price: (2026-09-10, read on their own pricing page) No seat price is published. Three plans are listed — Professional, Single-Line PowerDialer and Multi-Line PowerDialer — and no amount is rendered anywhere on the page; the billing toggle that used to sit above the cards has gone too, so there is now no path from this page to a number.

## KrispCall
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/krispcall-review.html
- Verdict: KrispCall: Essential $12 per user/mo billed annually or $15 monthly, for solo agents and teams up to 5 people. Same honest math as most budget VoIP.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 against the vendor's own pricing page) Essential $12 per user/mo billed annually or $15 monthly, for solo agents and teams up to 5 people; Standard $32 per user/mo annually or $40 monthly, for teams scaling up to 50 users; Enterprise custom. Annual saves 20%, which the page puts at $36 per user a year on Essential and $96 on Standard, and each plan comes with $1 of free calling and SMS credit.

## Lucrovox
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/lucrovox-review.html
- Verdict: Lucrovox: The phone agent has three published tiers and the plan table is back on the page. The ‘callers can’t tell it’s AI’ claim is the vendor’s own.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-24 on lucrovox.com/#pricing and lucrovox.com/lucrochat, both read in a real browser with the pages fully loaded) The phone agent has three published tiers and the plan table is back on the page: Starter $199 a month for up to 100 AI-handled calls, Pro $499 for up to 500 calls with CRM integration and advanced lead qualification, Enterprise $999 for up to 2,000 calls with white-label branding…

## NeuroAds
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/neuroads-review.html
- Verdict: NeuroAds: Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%). Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/neuroads-chatbot) Four tiers, priced by conversations per month. Free: 200 conversations, AI answers about products, collections and orders, rich product cards with add-to-cart, order status and tracking in chat, replies in the shopper's language.

## Pylon
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/pylon-review.html
- Verdict: Pylon no longer publishes rates. The per-seat sticker is the entry ticket; the AI that makes the platform sing is metered separately.
- Price: (checked 2026-09-01) Pylon no longer publishes rates. usepylon.com/pricing was republished on 1 September 2026 as a "Book a Demo" page carrying no plans, no per-seat rates and no seat minimums; the route to a number is a scheduled demo.

## Quo
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/quo-review.html
- Verdict: Quo: Business $23 annual ($276/yr) or $33 monthly. Call reliability is the recurring complaint — G2 logs hundreds of connection and disconnection reports.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page; quo.com refuses TLS to our usual client, so the page was fetched through our own European server — all prices are quoted on the page in USD) (2026) Three tiers: Starter $15/user/mo annual (billed $180/yr) or $19 monthly; Business $23 annual ($276/yr) or $33 monthly; Scale $35 annual ($420/yr) or $47 monthly. 7-day free trial.

## Readymode
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/readymode-review.html
- Verdict: Readymode — Two published plans, priced per license per month: Starter $239 for 1+ licenses and iQ $299. The per-seat price is premium.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 on their own pricing page, after the vendor announced a price change effective 1 Aug 2026) Two published plans, priced per license per month: Starter $239 for 1+ licenses and iQ $299, which the page calls ideal for 5+ licenses. Both waive the set-up fee and the phone-number (DID) activation fee, both give free outbound minutes subject to a fair-use policy, and both charge inbound at $0.02/min.

## respond.io
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/respond-io-review.html
- Verdict: respond.io — Four tiers, billed on monthly active contacts rather than seats: Starter $79/month, Growth $159, Advanced $279, and Enterprise on quote.
- Price: (2026-08-13, read off respond.io/pricing) Four tiers, billed on monthly active contacts rather than seats: Starter $79/month, Growth $159, Advanced $279, and Enterprise on quote. Paying yearly takes roughly 20% off — $948, $1,908 and $3,348 a year against $1,188, $2,388 and $4,188 monthly.

## Ruby
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/ruby-review.html
- Verdict: Ruby: $5.00 a minute at the bottom, $3.45 at the top. You're paying premium rates for real human receptionists billed per minute.
- Price: Read on their own plans-and-pricing page, 6 September 2026. Virtual receptionist plans are sold by monthly minutes: 50 minutes $250, 100 minutes $395, 200 minutes $720, 500 minutes $1,725 — $5.00 a minute at the bottom, $3.45 at the top.

## Salesmessage
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/salesmessage-review.html
- Verdict: Salesmsg — Monthly billing: Basic is $25 a month for 500 credits a month; Pro is $329 a month for 10,000 credits a month. Size the credits, not the headcount.
- Price: (2026-08-08, re-verified 10 September 2026 on www.salesmessage.com/pricing in both billing modes) Repackaged since our last check into two named plans plus Enterprise, metered in message credits. Monthly billing: Basic is $25 a month for 500 credits a month; Pro is $329 a month for 10,000 credits a month; Enterprise is contact-for-pricing with custom credits.

## Signal House
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/signal-house-review.html
- Verdict: Signal House: Usage-based, no platform subscription. The product is sold as an SMS and Voice API and the pricing page publishes no voice rate at all.
- Price: (2026-09-11, re-read on their own pricing page) Usage-based, no platform subscription. SMS on a 10DLC local number costs $0.0065 per segment with no minimum, falling on volume: $0.0050 from 500k segments a month, $0.0045 from 1m, $0.0040 from 2m, $0.0035 from 5m and $0.0030 from 10m.

## StoreFAQ
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/storefaq-review.html
- Verdict: StoreFAQ: Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving. The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase.
- Price: (read 2026-08-21 on apps.shopify.com/storefaq) Four tiers, metered on FAQ page views and AI chatbot conversations rather than on the number of FAQs. Free: 100 FAQ page views, unlimited FAQs and FAQ groups, the AI chatbot and AI-written FAQs, 25 AI conversations for the lifetime of the account, AI training on up to 50 products, export and import, instant answer with live chat and standard support.

## SupportBee
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/supportbee-review.html
- Verdict: SupportBee: Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month. Enterprise is listed as everything in Startup plus five named items.
- Price: (read 2026-08-27 on supportbee.com/pricing) Two plans, both priced per seat, and no free tier. Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month.

## Tidio
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/tidio-review.html
- Verdict: Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.
- Price: (read 2026-08-24 on www.tidio.com/pricing/ with both billing columns clicked, and on www.tidio.com) The plan table opens on the annual column, so the first figures on the page are not what month-to-month costs. Starter is 24.17 a month billed annually against 29 paid monthly, Growth starts at 49.17 annually against 59 monthly, and the two stand-alone add-ons follow the same 20 percent step: the Lyro AI Agent from…

## Vida AI
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/vida-ai-review.html
- Verdict: Vida AI: Vida publishes no public pricing. Every deployment starts with a scoped pilot from $1,500, credited toward your first month.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-09-10) Vida publishes no public pricing: no plan ladder, no monthly tier and no per-minute rate. Every deployment starts with a scoped pilot from $1,500, credited toward your first month in production, and the production price arrives as a quote afterwards.

## Wati
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/wati-review.html
- Verdict: Wati: Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, with a 7-day free trial and no setup fee.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-14, read on their own pricing page — which served us euros, not dollars) Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, with a 7-day free trial and no setup fee. Users are capped per tier: Growth includes 3 and lets you add none at all; Pro and Business include 5, with extra seats at €39 and €89 per user per month.

## Weave
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/weave-review.html
- Verdict: Weave: Practice owners commonly report all-in costs of roughly $400 to $700 a location once phones. The $199 starting price is a floor, not the bill.
- Price: Weave sells a per-location monthly subscription and its pricing page (weavehq.com/pricing, read 5 September 2026) now states plans start from $199 per location a month, though the exact tier ladder is still only shown after a demo. Practice owners commonly report all-in costs of roughly $400 to $700 a location once phones, payments and add-ons are bundled, plus a one-time setup fee of about $750.

## Zendesk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/zendesk-review.html
- Verdict: Zendesk — Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. The prices shown are annual-billed.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-12, read on their own pricing page from two countries) Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. Suite Enterprise + Copilot is quote-only.
